Proposal title: What's New in the Matrix Rust SDK
Abstract:
The Matrix Rust SDK has grown from an experimental client SDK into the
foundation that powers Element X and other Matrix applications. Along the way,
it has gained support for major Matrix features while tackling some interesting
engineering challenges.

In this talk, we'll explore recent additions to the SDK, including threads,
spaces, QR code login, shared encrypted history, migration from Element Classic
to Element X, and the centralized redecryption mechanism. We'll look at the
problems these features were designed to solve, the architectural decisions
behind them, and some of the lessons learned along the way.
